title: Annual Maintenance Report 2025
key_sentences: This report describes the maintenance work carried out on the Fennick Bridge in 2025.
All scheduled inspections were completed, and no structural defects were found.
The report covers the deck, the two piers and the drainage system.
Inspectors walked the full length of the deck in April and again in October.
The bridge remains in good condition overall.
Minor surface cracks were sealed on the eastern approach.
The expansion joints showed normal wear for their age.
Three drains near the western pier were blocked by leaves and were cleared in November.
We recommend a second cleaning visit each autumn from 2026 onwards.
The total cost of the work was 48,200 euros, which is 6 percent below the approved budget.
